semantics.out_and: 1 if and only if all four input bits are 1
semantics.out_or: 1 if and only if at least one input bit is 1
semantics.out_xor: 1 if and only if the number of input bits equal to 1 is odd
semantics.timing: Outputs continuously reflect current inputs after combinational settling; no clock or cycle latency
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization requirement

numeric.input: Four individual Boolean bits in an unsigned packed vector
numeric.arithmetic: Logical AND, OR and XOR over all four bits; no arithmetic rounding, truncation, saturation or overflow

verification.oracle: For each input, independently count asserted bits using a loop; AND is count==4, OR is count!=0, XOR is count modulo 2
verification.coverage: Exhaust all 16 binary input patterns, then repeat in reverse order to exercise changing inputs
verification.comparison: Check all three DUT outputs with case inequality after combinational settling
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp, finite command and testbench timeouts
verification.scope: Development simulation and static review only; no synthesis or official evaluation

specification_ambiguities: Original problem does not specify X/Z input behavior; binary inputs define the required verification domain and RTL uses standard SystemVerilog gate reduction semantics.
